title: Refuse backslash escapes in pack manifest paths on every host
goal: A pack manifest path that climbs out of the pack root with backslashes is refused on every host, not only on Windows, so a manifest means the same wherever it is validated and the GMCP requirement test gmcp_req_203_020_05_interop passes on Linux as it does on Windows.

reuse.reason: valid_file_component already splits on both separators; the escape check now does the same instead of walking host-specific path components. No new dependency; the function got shorter.

integration.workflow: susi harness run, native local workflow integrate

results.worker: governed subscription worker, one attempt, landed on the first pass
results.found_by: the landing gate of T-LOCALHARNESSZ0ROOTZ0PACKAGE-1 stopped on gmcp_req_203_020_05_interop (must reject unsafe path ..\escape.json), red on Linux since it landed from a Windows host
